- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release

Changes:
0: [home, redesign] Waiting Hub Pet Behavior Setup Redesign: Redesign the waiting screen into a split layout where users configure roaming boundaries while pet assets load. (why: The home waiting step has an 18.7% drop-off and a high median wait time of 201s; interactive behavior setup keeps users engaged.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Pet Selection Account Binding Step: Move sign-in to take place immediately after choosing a pet on pick_friend and before uploading photos or certificate creation. (why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after re-authenticating; binding the account right after selecting a pet secures asset ownership.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Retrieval Hint: Add an explicit callout on the sign-in screen reminding returning users to log in with their original sign-in provider to recover pets. (why: Support received 8 reports of users losing access to existing pets after signing in with a different credentials provider.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Visibility Diagnostic Timer Display: Display an active timer and desktop permission checklist during pet generation on the waiting screen. (why: Mean time spent on the waiting screen reaches 2336s and 3 users reported pets failing to appear on desktop.)
4: [home, notification] Background Pet Arrival System Alert: Offer a native tray notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get notified when background pet setup completes. (why: Very long mean home wait time (2336s) indicates users switch tasks and forget to return to the app.)
5: [finish, copy] Desktop Control Hotkeys Summary Copy: Update the home_intro text to clearly detail key desktop shortcuts for summoning, moving, and hiding the pet. (why: 3 support tickets raised confusion about how to control or hide the pet once setup finishes.)

scores.note: Interactive setup mitigates drop-off during the long 201s median wait on home step.
Reordering sign-in directly addresses 8 support emails about pet loss, but target step drop-off is small.
Low cost hint addressing 8 support emails, though sign-in drop-off is already relatively low (9.9%).
Timer and diagnostic checklist clarify extreme mean wait times (2336s) and fix reported setup confusion.
System tray notifications re-engage users who abandon during the extremely long 2336s mean home load time.
Copy change detailing hotkeys addresses 3 support tickets on a high drop-off step (31.3%).
